enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes steadily. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Moves arm. Moves leg. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns head. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Walks to sink. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs, bread, milk. Closes refrigerator. Places bread in toaster. Turns on toaster. Turns on induction cooker. Cracks eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing morning stretching and mobility exercises
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Rolls out exercise mat. Sits on mat. Stretches arms overhead. Bends forward. Twists torso left. Twists torso right. Stands up. Does leg swings. Does arm circles. Does neck rotations. Rolls up mat.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home due to the transport strike: conducting telehealth physiotherapy consultations and writing up treatment notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to study. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on computer. Opens telehealth software. Puts on headset. Conducts video consultation with patient. Speaks to patient. Demonstrates exercises. Ends call. Writes treatment notes on computer. Saves notes. Checks email. Makes another video call. Talks to patient. Ends call. Writes notes. Saves notes. Stands up to stretch. Sits back down.
Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Closes refrigerator. Places food in microwave. Turns on microwave. Removes food from microwave. Eats lunch. Drinks water. Washes dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking around the neighbourhood for fresh air and light exercise
enriched_activities.desc: Steps outside. Walks on sidewalk. Crosses street. Walks through park. Observes trees. Continues walking. Turns around. Walks back. Walks downhill.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: designing patient exercise programs and handling administrative tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to study. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on computer. Opens design software. Creates exercise program. Prints documents. Files paperwork. Makes phone calls. Writes email. Sends email. Organizes files. Checks schedule. Updates patient records. Saves files. Stands up to stretch. Sits back down. Continues working.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the washing machine and doing laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on light. Opens washing machine. Sorts dirty clothes. Checks pockets. Loads clothes into washing machine. Adds detergent. Closes washing machine. Sets cycle. Starts washing machine. Closes detergent bottle.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the sofa and checking the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens messaging app. Reads messages. Types reply. Sends reply. Opens social media. Scrolls. Puts down phone. Closes eyes.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables, meat. Closes refrigerator. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds oil. Cooks meat. Adds vegetables. Stirs food. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Washes dishes.

Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Presses channel button. Watches screen. Adjusts volume. Leans back. Crosses legs. Uncrosses legs. Picks up phone. Checks phone. Puts down phone. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading physiotherapy journals and continuing professional education
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to study. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens journal. Reads. Takes notes. Highlights text. Turns page. Continues reading. Closes journal. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up.
Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Wets body. Applies soap. Rinses body. Washes hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Dries with towel. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down on the phone and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on light. Sits on bed. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens social media. Scrolls. Watches video. Puts down phone. Changes into pajamas. Folds clothes. Turns off light. Lies down.

Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes steadily. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Moves arm. Moves leg. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns head. Continues sleeping.
